notes: Eleven distinct movable-part episodes are visible. The two pairs of upper cabinet leaves are reported separately because each leaf is an independently movable part; their exact within-stride ordering is less certain than the other transitions.
scene_description: A first-person traversal of a kitchen in which the user sequentially opens and closes a refrigerator, dishwasher, oven, pantry and upper cabinets, followed by manipulating two cooker lids and an air-fryer drawer.
